title: Check validator return and process outcome independently
summary: Installed validateConfig explicitly returns null on success. New wrapper requires exit zero, no signal/error/stderr and explicit null payload; undefined and empty output fail.

changes.detail: Replace incorrect undefined expectation with the inspected null contract and strict subprocess checks.
Regression cases for absent output, undefined, rejection, nonzero exit, timeout, signal and stderr.
